Once a simulation study is complete, the agent takes the results data and automatically generates a report aligned to a customer's own reporting templates, including findings, relevant charts, and recommendations.

articles.summary: Connect and interact with all your data in one place. Rescale now connects engineering data stored in AWS S3 and Azure Blob Storage directly to the Rescale Assistant through vectorized search. Once connected, engineers can ask natural language questions and receive fast, contextually grounded answers drawn from their organization's own data, rather than relying only on general AI knowledge or manual file searches.
